# Phase 5 — Identity and Access Control

Follow Copilot instructions and Identity & Access Control specification (if present), API auth requirements and threat model. Implement principal types/context, identity propagation, authentication adapter interface and server-side authorization with least privilege, role/capability checks, and tenant/resource scoping where specified. Reject spoofed identity headers; trust only validated credentials/context. Implement revocation/error handling and test unauthenticated, unauthorized, cross-scope, malformed-claim, and privilege-boundary cases. Do not choose IdP or token format if unresolved; report decision options and block provider-specific work. Acceptance: protected resources checked every access; denial fails closed; identity context trustworthy; security tests pass.
